# Verify stashedHTML2text works on the raw_label
import markdown
from markdown.util import code_escape
from markdown.extensions.toc import stashedHTML2text

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"
result = md.convert(text)

# Get the raw label from the element after attr_list processed it
for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
        raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
        print(f"raw_label={raw_label!r}")
        
        # Apply code_escape then stashedHTML2text
        escaped = code_escape(raw_label)
        print(f"after code_escape={escaped!r}")
        
        result_text = stashedHTML2text(escaped, md, strip_entities=False)
        print(f"after stashedHTML2text={result_text!r}")
